All four packages are written, but I could not run `npm test` in any of them. Bash was denied in this session, so none of the code or tests has been executed. I checked the test expectations by hand against the code, but please run `npm test` in each folder before relying on this.

## `settingskit/`
- **`src/layer.mjs`** (new) exports `layer(base, over)`.
- **`tests/layer.test.mjs`** (new) has a test for each checklist point.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** has a line under `## Unreleased` (line 5).

Checklist, with where each item is met:
1. `src/layer.mjs:63` exports `layer`.
2. Key-by-key layering is `overlay` (`src/layer.mjs:36-48`). Anything else in `over` replaces the base value, and arrays are replaced whole. Tests: "layered key by key", "at any depth", "replaces whatever base holds", "replaced whole".
3. The `TypeError` checks are at `src/layer.mjs:64-65`. They cover array, `null`, string, number, `Date`, `Map`, function and a missing argument. Test: "both arguments must be plain objects".
4. `copy` (`src/layer.mjs:17-33`) deep-copies base and every value taken from `over`, arrays included. Tests: "shares no object or array", "neither argument is changed".
5. `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` are skipped at `src/layer.mjs:28` and `:39`, and results are built as `{}`. Tests: "unsafe keys are never copied", "an unsafe key in over".
6. See `CHANGELOG.md:5`.
7. Not verified, because I could not run `npm test`. There are no skipped or todo tests.
8. Only `src/layer.mjs`, `tests/layer.test.mjs` and `CHANGELOG.md` changed.

Choices I made beyond the task:
- `Date` values are copied rather than shared.
- A circular structure throws `TypeError`.
- Objects with a null prototype count as plain.
- Any other non-plain value, such as a class instance, is kept by reference.

## `textwrap/`
- **`src/wrap.mjs`** (new) exports `wrapText(text, width, { breakLongWords = true })`.
- **`tests/wrap.test.mjs`** (new) covers it.
- **`README.md`** now documents the contract. The README had no wrapping spec, so I wrote one.

The contract:
- Lines are filled greedily and input line breaks are kept.
- Whitespace within a line collapses to one space.
- Words longer than `width` are split, unless `breakLongWords` is false.
- Width is counted in code points.
- A non-string `text` or non-number `width` throws `TypeError`; a width that is not a positive integer throws `RangeError`.

## `csvline/`
- **`src/csv.mjs`**: `parseCsvLine` is rewritten as a single-pass, linear-time scanner that implements every README rule and throws only `CsvError` (plus `TypeError` for non-strings).
- **`tests/csv.test.mjs`**: the existing tests are untouched and extended. New tests cover each contract line, 100 KB records in several shapes with a one-second bound, and a seeded fuzz check that only fields or a `CsvError` come out.

## `semver-mini/`
- **`src/semver.mjs`**: `compare` is implemented per semver.org §2, §9, §10 and §11.
  - Strict grammar validation throws `RangeError`; non-strings throw `TypeError`.
  - Core versions compare as `BigInt`, so very large numbers are safe.
  - Pre-release identifiers follow §11, and build metadata is ignored.
- The tests were not changed.

I did not use subagents or the grooph tools.
